products.title: Kashmiri Bangles Wedding Favors
products.description:
Delight your wedding guests with this charming set of 4 Kashmiri bangles featuring delicate, chiming ghungroos. Presented on a custom-designed backing card personalized with your names and event date, these traditional keepsakes are ideal for mehendi, sangeet, haldi, and nikah favors.

✾Includes: Set of 4 Kashmiri bangles

✾Personalization: Custom couple names and event date on packaging card

✾Ideal For: Indian and South Asian pre-wedding celebrations and ceremonies

products.title: Personalized Wedding Welcome Board (A1 Canvas)

Fully personalized with your names and special date, this piece makes a stunning centerpiece for your venue entrance.

✾Includes: 1x A1-size personalized canvas sign (Please note: Easel is not included)

✾Personalization: Custom couple names, welcome message, and event date

✾Ideal For: Wedding venue entrances, receptions, mehendi ceremonies, and sangeet night decor
